question: Which plumber near 75206 is the best fit for a water heater replacement this week, and why?
derivation: Derived from the raw data pack by a separate pass that never read the implementation. Candidates = the 6 profiles with trade plumbing (CRM accounts merged on phone; Lone Star's Housecall Pro and Workiz accounts are one provider). 'Near 75206' = the provider declares 75206 (5 of 6; Rapid Rooter TX does not and has 1 job there). Water-heater replacement = 6 phrase families (new water heater, WH replace, replace water heater, water heater install, water heater replacement, tankless conversion); repair, flush, pilot and no-hot-water jobs are counted separately. Counts are completed jobs over the last 24 months. 'This week' = [2026-11-02, 2026-11-09) America/Chicago; a replacement needs about 4.5 h (median 4.25-5 h). Openings use the crew-aware model (D-041). The spec says Q6 has no single right answer: correct = a complete, explained, sourced ranking (R21), so the eval checks defensible constraints rather than one order.
tolerance: The ranking must be an ordered list (scores non-increasing; rank fields, if present, 1..n) in which every entry has a numeric score, a non-empty list of factors, sources on every factor, and an availability confidence. Every candidate with mustInclude=true must appear exactly once; Rapid Rooter TX may appear but not first. Constraints: Lone Star Plumbing in the top 2, Greenville Ave Plumbing in the top 3, Dallas Drain Pros / Tejas Rooter / Rapid Rooter TX not first, Dallas Drain Pros marked as having no water-heater history (G21). mustNotAppear names fail if listed as candidates.
